name: Nelson
source:
An elderly cat kept by the Violet family. Despite his aged appearance, he is said to be very popular among female cats. He can understand and speak human language, and he is surprisingly quick-witted and observant. It seems he also knows the secret about the Violet sisters...

[Translated from the [url=https://twin-angel-psp.com/character7.html]official site[/url]]
